summary: Implemented `in` membership for Namespace and ClosedNamespace in rdflib/namespace.py, plus tests in test/test_namespace.py. Namespace.__contains__ returns ref.startswith(self) (prefix test). ClosedNamespace.__contains__ returns any(ref == uri for uri in self.__uris.values()) (node-type-aware closed test); _RDFNamespace inherits it. The IPython key-completion hook now returns dir(self.uri). Added tests for prefix membership (positive, self, proper-prefix negative, contains-but-not-prefix negative), SH, RDFS closed (positive, undefined-term negative, plain string and Literal negatives), and RDF closed (positive, container-property negative). Nothing was run: tests and doctests are unverified, per instructions. No commits were made.
